Tooltip

Wraps one element and shows a short text label on hover and keyboard focus.

Source src/react/Feedback.tsx See it in the gallery

Example

Scroll →
tsx 
import { Button, Tooltip } from "@osqd/ui"; <Tooltip title="Restart the node">  <Button variant="soft" color="neutral">Restart</Button></Tooltip>
html 
<button type="button" data-tip="Restart the node" class="oq-btn oq-neutral oq-btn--soft">Restart</button>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
titlerequired string — —
placement "top" | "bottom" | "right" "top" —
childrenrequired ReactNode — One element; it receives data-tip. Text is wrapped in a span.
